_help: Website settings. Change the words between the quote marks. See README.md for what each one does.
tagline: News and stories from the eight states of Northeast India
_whatsappHelp: Paste your WhatsApp Channel link here (it starts with https://whatsapp.com/channel/). The WhatsApp buttons appear on the site once this is filled.
_googleHelp: Only needed if Google Search Console asks for an 'HTML tag': paste just the code inside content="..." here.

liveChannels._help: Official government channels listed on the Live page (name and YouTube link). Add more the same way; check each link is the real, official channel first.

social._help: Links to your social media pages. Leave empty ("") to hide one. They appear as a row of buttons in the footer.

publisher._help: Shown on the About, Contact and Grievance pages. Fill in the real details before applying for ads.
publisher.name: InsightNE News
publisher._showEditorNameHelp: false = the editor's name is hidden on the website: the About, Team and Editorial policy pages and your story bylines show the defaultAuthor (InsightNE News Desk) instead. Change to true to show the name again.

_widerHelp: National and world news is included only when it is important, and at most maxOutsideNortheastPerRun such stories are kept per run, so Northeast news always comes first.

editors._help: People who sign in with EDITOR_PASSWORD. If canPublish is true, the stories they write go live straight away; if false, they wait in Pending for the admin.

facebook._help: Posting to your Facebook page. Needs FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID and FACEBOOK_PAGE_TOKEN in Vercel (see docs/5-FACEBOOK.md). autoPost: "originals" = your own reports are posted automatically when published; true = every story you approve; false = only with the POST TO FACEBOOK button.

instagram._help: Posting the news-card picture to the Instagram account linked to your Facebook page (same page key as Facebook, with Instagram permissions added). autoPost: "originals" = your own reports automatically; true = every story you approve; false = only with the POST TO INSTAGRAM button. enabled: false hides Instagram completely.

autoPublish._help: News briefs from other sites go live WITHOUT your approval when enabled is true, the story scores minScore or more out of 10, it has a summary, and it is NOT marked NEEDS EXTRA CHECK (crime, violence, religion, communities, rumours, copied words). Everything else waits for you. Set enabled to false to approve everything yourself again.

cricket._help: The India men's score box follows only matches against this opponent (exact team name, e.g. "New Zealand", "Pakistan"). Leave it empty "" to show any India men's match.
